explication: mngr is a Unix-style CLI for creating, managing, and connecting to coding agents across local and remote hosts. The main workflow is a user invoking CLI commands, which load the plugin system and operate on agents through provider-backed compute; users can then connect, message, transfer work, or snapshot and clone agent state. The repository also includes an SSH-forwarding plugin and provider implementations. Edges are limited to relationships stated in the README or visible in the supplied source index and excerpts; unsampled internals are not assumed.
